svg.text: Word Coffee · from a local work brief
A blocked phrase cannot be typed into a text layer. It is not a warning at export — the layer will not accept it.
Kit applied to 19 of 19 assets · 1 claim blocked at compose time · evidence ledger: 2 sources attached

Render 07 — PROPOSED: Brand system station. Brand voice ALREADY EXISTS in the repo (Northstar_backend/social_pulse.py load_brand_voice() with tone / style / hashtags_per_post / emoji_usage / call_to_action, and listing_forge.py's brand_voice dict threaded into every prompt builder). What is NEW: the claims library, the evidence ledger, and enforcement at compose time rather than at export.
